instruction: more_itertools.nth_permutation(iterable, r, index) raises ValueError when r is larger than the number of items, but then there are simply no permutations of length r, so every index is out of range: it must raise IndexError (nth_permutation('abc', 5, 0) raises IndexError). Only a negative r raises ValueError. Everything else is unchanged: r=None or r equal to the length means full permutations, a negative index counts from the end, and an index outside the range raises IndexError.
